provenance: These tapes were recorded on 2026-11-09 from the official Midnight nodes (2.1.101-913ec011) with UmbraDB's tools/tape range recorder at the collection source commit, for the runtime 2.1 delayed upgrade to 2,001,100 (ledger v9) on mainnet, preprod and preview; they are used by midnightntwrk/umbradb's test/ledger/delayed-upgrade.test.ts. They were recorded with --live-seconds 0 (no live window), unlike the 0.10.0-rc.1 collection's 60 seconds. Filenames may change; tape bytes and SHA-256 identities are preserved.

recorder.provenanceNote: Recorded with tools/tape/main.ts range from working branches of midnightntwrk/umbradb whose tools/tape was identical to main at the integrated source commit (checked by diff); their own commits were later re-signed or merged, so the integrated commit identifies the recorder's source.

historicalManifest.name: mainnet-3346039-3346239
historicalManifest.bounds: Mainnet's delayed runtime upgrade to 2,001,100 (ledger v9, runtime 2.1's system_version 3), 100 blocks either side: block 3346138 (0x0dd469de…) carries the staged upgrade and still holds runtime 1,000,300 in its state; block 3346139 (0x952f999b…) is the first the new runtime built, its MNSV digest and own state 2,001,100, its parent's state 1,000,300. Replayed across it a selection that decodes a block with its parent's runtime only halts there with metadata-mismatch.

notes.recordedWith: npx tsx tools/tape/main.ts range --node wss://rpc.mainnet.midnight.network --from 3346039 --to 3346239 --out mainnet-3346039-3346239.tape.jsonl --concurrency 4 --live-seconds 0
notes.servesOnItsOwn: the delayed upgrade's first block, replayed with core-contract-logs-fast's core from a block before it: test/ledger/delayed-upgrade.test.ts
notes.needs: the network's genesis hash and header put before its records (startup asks for them; test/ledger/fixtures/networks/)
notes.liveWindowNote: Recorded with --live-seconds 0: the tape ends with the two subscriptions, the finalized head and two notifications, not a 60-second window.
notes.eventKindsNote: Counted from 3,346,040 to 3,346,239: a mid-chain replay anchors on the tape's first block.

historicalManifest.name: preview-0-2000-v8-v9
historicalManifest.bounds: Preview from genesis after its restart from the same genesis hash, over both of its runtime upgrades: 1,000,000 to 1,000,300 at 556 and 1,000,300 to 2,001,100 (ledger v9) at 1,572. Its 21 regular transactions are all at genesis: no contract call before the v9 runtime. It is the first official network's delayed runtime upgrade (runtime 2.1's system_version 3) on a tape that starts at genesis. Recorded as preview-v9-0-2000.tape.jsonl and renamed to the tapes collection's naming ({network}-{start}-{end}[-{notes}]); the bytes and SHA-256 are unchanged.

notes.recordedWith: npx tsx tools/tape/main.ts range --node wss://rpc.preview.midnight.network --from 0 --to 2000 --out preview-0-2000-v8-v9.tape.jsonl --concurrency 4 --live-seconds 0
notes.servesOnItsOwn: preview's new chain from genesis across an upgrade of the earlier form (556) and a delayed one (1,572): test/ledger/delayed-upgrade.test.ts
notes.liveWindowNote: Recorded with --live-seconds 0: the tape ends with the two subscriptions, the finalized head and two notifications, not a 60-second window.
